title: Website Tech Stack, Security & AI-Readiness Auditor Input

urls.title: Target Website URLs
urls.description: List of domains or full URLs to audit (e.g., https://stripe.com or linear.app).

checkAiReadiness.title: Check AI-Readiness (llms.txt & robots.txt)
checkAiReadiness.description: Probe /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, and /robots.txt to check GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and OAI-SearchBot permissions.

checkSitemap.title: Check sitemap.xml
checkSitemap.description: Check whether /sitemap.xml exists and estimate indexed URL count.

extractContacts.title: Extract Public Emails & Social Links
extractContacts.description: Extract public business contact emails and social profiles (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, GitHub, YouTube, Instagram) found on the landing page.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of websites to audit in parallel (1-20).
